full_judgment: 2. Facts in short are that the petitioners as plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No. 707 of 2023 against four Financial Institutions, namely, United Commercial Bank PLC, IFIC Bank PLC, Basic bank Limited and the Bangladesh Bank for a decree for declaring that classifying the loan accounts of the plaintiffs and designating them as a loan defaulters and sending their names to the Bangladesh Bank for inclusion in the CIB report are illegal and unlawful.
